feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 September 2026 10:48pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 22 September 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is eroded from the northwest by a developing frontal wave which will move quickly across the Irish Sea tomorrow morning.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 2 to 4, veering and increasing North or Northwest 5 or 6 late tonight or at first tomorrow morning, decreasing 4 or 5 later in morning or early afternoon, 3 or 4 in evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain then arriving from the northwest later tonight, soon clearing tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Becoming Variable 2 or 3 for a time tomorrow night, then settling South or Southeast 3 or 4 later. Increasing mainly South 5 or 6 on Thursday morning, although mainly a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
